events.event_name: CookUnity — The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Five Manhattan bodegas: 451 3rd Ave; 266 W 23rd St; 369 Madison Ave; 275 W 4th St; 873 Broadway, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas where award-winning chefs serve complimentary signature meals and hot bites, with a bodega-style scratch-off promotion.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary CookUnity meals or hot bites while supplies last; each guest also receives a scratch-off ticket for a chance at additional prizes.
events.caveats: Current same-day event coverage agrees on Thursday, September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM and five Manhattan bodega locations. Average Socialite explicitly describes it as open to the public and NYC for FREE says anyone who walks into a participating location receives a complimentary signature dish. Food is supply-limited. No RSVP or ticket requirement was published in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM. Participating locations: Slice n' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway. Arrive early because meals/hot bites are while supplies last.

events.what_it_is: TEMPTATIONS' first Cat Bodega, a free immersive pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats with photo moments, cat treats, games and bodega-inspired merchandise prizes.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat treats plus chances to win exclusive Cat Bodega merchandise through onsite games; prizes and game pieces are while supplies last.
events.caveats: TEMPTATIONS' official Sept. 9 announcement and promotion terms confirm Sept. 17–19, 12–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery, free public access, no purchase necessary, free treats and prize opportunities. A secondary listing gives 216 Bowery, but the first-party brand source and official promotion terms control here: 213 Bowery. Onsite prizes/game pieces are limited and may run out before closing.
events.practical_notes: Thursday–Saturday Sept. 17–19, 12–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. Free treats and merchandise-prize games are supply-limited.

events.address: Robert F. Wagner Jr. Park, 20 Battery Pl, New York, NY 10280
events.what_it_is: A three-night waterfront light-art festival with large-scale installations, projection mapping, DJs, performances and interactive art at Wagner Park.
events.what_is_free: Festival admission and access to the light-art installations and performances are free; food and beverages are available for purchase.
events.caveats: Illumination NYC's official site confirms Sept. 17–19 at Wagner Park and links directly to free Eventbrite tickets. The organizer's Eventbrite listing confirms 7–11 PM nightly, free admission, 20 Battery Place and all-ages access. Registration is free and directly actionable; food and beverages are not included.
events.practical_notes: Thursday–Saturday Sept. 17–19, 7–11 PM nightly at Wagner Park. Free organizer registration is available through the Eventbrite link from Illumination NYC's official site.

events.event_name: Yepoda — The Dewy Day Tour at Sephora Union Square
events.address: Sephora Union Square, 40 E 14th St, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's second NYC Dewy Day Tour stop outside Sephora Union Square, with K-beauty try-ons, free gifts, prize opportunities and separate purchase-based gift-with-purchase offers.
events.what_is_free: Free gifts while supplies last and chances to win Sephora gift cards and full-size products. No purchase is necessary to attend or receive the non-purchase freebies; separate GWP tiers require qualifying Sephora purchases.
events.caveats: The organizer-published Eventbrite listing confirms Sunday, September 20, 12–6 PM at Sephora Union Square, 40 E 14th St, and says no purchase is necessary to attend and receive freebies. This is a distinct NYC occurrence from the Sept. 19 Sephora Meatpacking stop already represented on the site, so it is published separately rather than changing the Meatpacking address.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, 12–6 PM at Sephora Union Square, 40 E 14th St. Free gifts are while supplies last; use the organizer Eventbrite listing for current registration availability.

events.event_name: Cj Hendry's Flower Market at Rockefeller Center
events.address: Center Plaza, 30 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10112
events.what_it_is: Cj Hendry's public Flower Market returns to Rockefeller Center with an immersive plaza installation and a new collection of plush flowers modeled on flowers native to New York City.
events.what_is_free: Entry is free and every guest receives one free plush flower. Additional flowers cost $5; an optional paid Flower Market Express ticket provides priority entry plus Top of the Rock admission.
events.caveats: Rockefeller Center's official event page confirms Sept. 24–27, free entry and one free flower per guest. Hours are Sept. 24 from 1–8 PM and Sept. 25–27 from 10 AM–8 PM, but are explicitly subject to change based on flower availability. The paid Flower Market Express option is priority entry, not a requirement for general admission.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 24: 1–8 PM. Sept. 25–27: 10 AM–8 PM. Hours can shorten based on flower availability. General entry and the first flower are free; optional paid Express access skips the line.
